name: MedSender
desc:
Archived due to scale mismatch. Medsender is a small, early-stage company (26 employees, NYC-based) with only 1-2 openings at a time and heavy national competition for each one. Not a practical fit for WRO's volume. Revisit only if the company grows significantly
Customer Support Specialist | $60,000 - $80,000/yr + Equity + Bonus | Email/Chat Heavy, Minimal Phone | 
Industry: Health-Tech / Healthcare Communication / SaaS

Realistic Job Overview and Responsibilities:
Medsender is an AI-powered healthcare communication platform that automates the processing of patient information, replacing fax-based workflows used by medical offices, hospitals, pharmacies, and imaging centers. Customers contact support when they cannot figure out the product, hit a bug, or need help setting up a workflow. This role is the first person they reach. 
Key responsibilities from the posting:
Own the support queue (L1): respond to customer questions via email and chat, with occasional Zoom calls
Troubleshoot Medsender workflows and distinguish between user error and product bugs
Escalate bugs to Engineering with detailed reproduction steps, screenshots, and customer impact notes
Help onboard new users with walkthroughs and best practices as needed
Write and maintain help articles, internal runbooks, and templates
Contribute to support operations including tagging, routing, and trend reporting
Handle sensitive patient information in compliance with HIPAA
This is explicitly not a call center role. Primary communication is written. The job requires strong written communication, logical troubleshooting, and comfort working closely with a product and engineering team at a small company.

Pay: $60,000 to $80,000 per year, salaried. Plus equity and bonus potential. This is one of the higher-paying support roles in the database and includes equity, meaning participants get a small ownership stake in the company.
Shift: Full-time, 40 hours per week. Monday through Friday implied. Flexible remote environment noted.
Benefits: Not fully detailed in posting. Described as competitive. Participants should ask for the full breakdown during the recruiter screen.
 Equipment: Provided (company standard for remote roles). No specific internet requirements listed.
assessment: SaaS support companies commonly use written communication assessments, customer service scenarios, troubleshooting exercises, and problem-solving evaluations during hiring..
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Success depends heavily on written communication skills, problem solving, and attention to detail.
Education Minimum: Not stated. The posting welcomes recent graduates with strong evidence of organization and fast learning.
Required Experience:
Customer-facing experience of any kind: support, operations, hospitality, retail, or internships
Reliable internet at home
Preferred Experience:
SaaS product support experience
Healthcare workflow familiarity
Basic technical concepts such as APIs, webhooks, or browser troubleshooting
Required Skills:
Excellent written communication and customer empathy
Structured problem-solving and strong attention to detail
Ability to learn new software quickly as the product evolves
High ownership and follow-through on open issues
Comfort operating independently in a remote startup environment
 Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with strong written communication skills who wants a high-ownership support role with real growth potential
People with any customer-facing background who are tech-comfortable and learn software quickly
Participants interested in health-tech or SaaS who want startup experience with competitive pay
Anyone who wants a path into Customer Success, Support Operations, or technical support roles over time
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who needs a structured, process-heavy environment with established playbooks. Medsender is small and still building those
Participants who are not comfortable with ambiguity or evolving workflows
People who prefer phone-heavy communication over written
Anyone uncomfortable with HIPAA compliance and handling sensitive patient data
 Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Customer support
SaaS support
Troubleshooting
HIPAA compliance
Help documentation
Bug escalation
Healthcare workflows
Onboarding
Support operations
Written communication
